name: Kamar
description: Kamar was a dry and arid planet located in Wild Space, home to the insectoid Kamarian species and the howlrunner. It had deserts and mountains across its surface that scorched under the hot-white sun. Various plant life such as the miser-plant, barrel-scrub, and sting-brush sprouted up.
lead_paragraphs: Kamar was a dry and arid planet located in Wild Space, home to the insectoid Kamarian species and the howlrunner. It had deserts and mountains across its surface that scorched under the hot-white sun. Various plant life such as the miser-plant, barrel-scrub, and sting-brush sprouted up.
Other creatures native to Kamar included digworms, stingworms, bloodsniffers, and nightswifts.
